title: Abba Antoli
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Demai 5:8: Rabbi Zeira said that Abba Antoli bought fruit from a gentile. He came to Rabbi Yehudah ben Levi, who sent word to Menachem, his son, to separate the required tithes from his fruit.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The notice’s pronominal references to “his son” and “his fruit” are retained; the English does not add new family or property identifications.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Demai 5:8 paragraph reads Abba Anatoli and says that he came to Rabbi Yehudah ben Levi, who sent to Menachem his son. The English follows that direction of movement, correcting the earlier reversal. Hyman’s supplied Antoli spelling and the notice’s pronouns are retained without creating a new family or property identification.
